Games The 5 top games you need to play in November 2026 Best Lists By Emma-Jane Betts Published 29 October 2026 A complete list of the best games releasing in November (aka GTA 6 month) When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter 2026 has been one of the busiest in terms of game releases; however, November is one of the quietest. Thanks to GTA 6's launch, a ton of titles have been avoiding the month like the plague, but there are still some standouts that haven't gone running to the digital hills that should be on your radar. So, the rest of the GamesRadar+ team and I have decided to highlight all of them for you below in a handy round-up. From the big major Rockstar outing to a bunch of surprising Nintendo goodness, the good news is that there really is something for everyone here. I will also say that although they didn't make this particular list, there are also a bunch of upcoming indie games releasing in November, so I highly recommend checking out our full guide on all the new games for 2026 and (beyond) for a full picture. But with all that out of the way, let's dive into the top 5 games you need to play this November, in no particular order. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: The best games to play in November 2026 World of Warcraft Forever (Image credit: Blizzard Entertainment) Release date: November 4, 2026 Platforms: PC World of Warcraft Forever aims to return to what made WoW so iconic two decades ago, while introducing new and expanded zones, new dungeons, raids, skills, talents, new playable race, over 1000 quests, updated visuals and way more that I've run out of breath for. If you are an RPG fan or a veteran of the MMO, then this should definitely be in your sightline and you can read more about the impending releases with our World of Warcraft: Forever Big Preview breakdown. You may like The 5 best games you need to play in October 2026 The 5 best games you need to play in September 2026 New games 2026 and beyond: The biggest video game release dates for PS5, Xbox Series X, PC, Switch, and more Watch the trailer The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake (Image credit: Nintendo) Release date: November 5, 2026 Platforms: Switch 2 The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is getting a remake for the Switch 2 and as a Nintendo fan, this is a must-buy. The upcoming Switch 2 game is a full ground-up reimagining of the classic 1998 N64 action-adventure title, with modernized gameplay including a jump button (I know), updated graphics that have divided the internet, fully voice-acted cutscenes, and other new additions too. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is one of the best and most influential games ever made so needless to say, its remake is a big deal. Watch the trailer Guardians of the Galaxy Encore Edition (Image credit: Eidos Montreal) Release date: November 6, 2026 Platforms: Switch 2 Ok, it may only be a Switch 2 port but this superhero RPG deserves so much more love than it got at launch, so take this as your sign to dive into Star-Lord's adventure. Not only will Switch 2 players finally get to experience the clean story and snappy gameplay of Guardians of the Galaxy, but the Encore Edition also comes with an all new set of glam rock outfits for the Guardians, and the same kickass soundtrack. And, if you need some extra convincing to pick this one up (especially if you aren't a big Marvel fan) I suggest reading our Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy review to change your mind. Watch the trailer Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy (Image credit: Nintendo) Release date: November 12, 2026 Platforms: Switch 2 You may like The 5 best games you need to play in October 2026 The 5 best games you need to play in September 2026 With the GTA 6 shadow looming, Gamescom suddenly feels like the most essential gaming event of 2026 Switch 2 is getting another new game this month, and it's Pikmin 4! Now I have a personal soft spot for Pikmin, but for good reason. The iconic series has given us some of the best and cutest adventure puzzle games around, and I personally love all the recent co-op experiences I've had with them as well with my partner. Pikmin 4 is a dream already but the Switch 2 version comes with support for voice commands for our old pal Oatchi, graphical and gameplay upgrades, and even a new mode called Dandori Academy. Don't say you don't get nice things. Watch the trailer GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar) Release date: November 19, 2026 Platforms: PS5, Xbox Series X/S Does this one really need any introduction? Of course, this was always going to make our standouts list for the month. The Rockstar epic that we've been waiting 13 years for, GTA 6 is finally coming in November after a series of delays, bringing with it a brand new take on Miami, the first playable female hero, and so much more we're no doubt going to be talking about it for another 13 years to come. So far we have seen impressive trailers, had a bunch of pre-order and size information, and honestly, excitement and anticipation is skyhigh for everyone here at GamesRadar+ for this bad boy to finally drop.
